_comment: The Events page. 'weekly' is the regular rhythm of the assemblies. 'upcoming' holds one-off events: outreaches, conferences, Ghana trip dates. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD and times 24-hour HH:MM in the event's own time zone. Past events drop off automatically at the next build. Example upcoming entry: {"title": "Community outreach", "date": "2026-11-14", "start": "10:00", "end": "13:00", "tz": "America/Denver", "place": "Karis International Assembly", "address": "5905 Flintridge Drive, Colorado Springs, CO 80918", "description": "Door-to-door with tracts, then lunch together.", "link": "resources.html#tracts"}
